name: Pi
tagline: Minimal, hackable coding agent: four tools and extensions for the rest.
description: pi (pi-mono by Mario Zechner) is deliberately small: pi-ai talks to 15+ providers, pi-agent-core runs the loop, and the coding agent ships read, write, edit and bash. No permission system, no built-in memory or subagents; everything else is a TypeScript extension or a pi package. Sessions are a branching tree you can export or share.
